prompts.states: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet for a 2D Ben 10 fan fighting game. Reference image is Water Hazard's design reference, NOT a scene to reproduce. Create Water Hazard in clean authentic Ultimate Alien cartoon cel-animation style: precise black outlines, flat rich red shell armor with just one hard-edged darker shade, black flexible joints and face, green eyes, grey mouth disc, green hourglass emblem on center chest, big red shell gauntlets with blue water ports, broad red three-toed armored feet. Keep precisely ONE consistent character model, face, helmet, torso width, armor details and limb proportions in ALL eight poses. Do not turn him into a robot, lobster monster or different alien. No 3D material, gradients, textures, lighting style changes, water jets, glow or effects. Transparent background. Exactly eight separate complete full-body frames arranged in a precise four-column two-row grid, generous transparent gutters, no frame overlaps, no text or grid lines. All frames face screen-right in the same three-quarter side-view camera. Top row left-to-right: 1 ultimate preparation braced knees both gauntlets drawn back, 2 ultimate release both gauntlets aimed screen-right together, 3 ultimate recovery arms returning to guard, 4 neutral standing hero stance. Bottom row left-to-right: 5 defensive guard forearms raised protecting torso, 6 nonlethal standing hit recoil leaning back slightly with feet still under body, 7 defeated lying sideways on ground, 8 forward dash lean with legs pushing off. Exactly these eight poses, no other characters. Constant adult humanoid body size across the sheet; raised arms may change total silhouette height but head and torso must retain their scale. Crisp large native cels suitable for downscaling, landscape canvas approximately 2048 by1024.

Exactly eight complete separate full-body poses in a four-column/two-row grid, generous transparent outer margins and gutters, no overlap, no text, no labels, no effects, no water images, no ground shadow. Keep the head and torso at the same native scale across poses; no model swapping. Preserve all limbs and helmet inside the canvas. Canvas wide 2:1 at high native resolution, crisp for downscaling. Eight consecutive chronological walking cycle frames left-to-right then next row: contact left foot forward; down/compression; passing legs; rising; opposite contact right foot forward; opposite down; opposite passing; opposite rising returning naturally to frame1. Weighty armored humanoid locomotion with small deliberate torso motion, natural opposite arm swing. Both big gauntlets stay attached, no duplicated limbs, no attack poses or hovering.
